text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower has managed to leave<n>quite a mark on
the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Together, we've successfully<n>navigated the crucial
first three years<n>of her career.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Welcome back... Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Welcome back... Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I'm a little embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if the blue rose from the<n>picture book felt
like this, too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, yeah. Remember the story ofThe Blue Rose of Good Fortune?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, yeah. Remember the story ofThe Blue Rose of Good Fortune?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...The blue rose is placed on the big<n>brother's
windowsill to cheer up the<n>people walking past.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...The blue rose is placed on the big<n>sister's
windowsill to cheer up the<n>people walking past.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I've learned so much these past<n>three years and
made new<n>discoveries along the way... even in<n>this
book I've read so many times.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Until now, I thought that the windowsill<n>was the best
place for that rose to be<n>seen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But... now I think that the windowsillwas the best place for the rose tosee...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
From there, I bet it could see the big<n>brother
whenever he came home.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
From there, I bet it could see the big<n>sister
whenever she came home.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And I'm sure it always waited<n>excitedly... to spend
time with the<n>person it loved the most.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Can I ask you a question?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Can I ask you a question?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Have I blossomed as well? Do I...<n>deserve a place
on the windowsill?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I'm glad.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I... I want to continue to bloom with<n>you by my side...
forever and ever!
